description: Routine persisted to user_state must be immediately readable via get_current_schedule and /api/schedule without regeneration.
Mutating dinner timings from 19:30 to 20:00 must leave unrelated practices (e.g. Trataka / Reflection at 21:30) completely untouched.
When an adaptation proposal is rejected by user, the schedule in the database must not change by even one minute.
Mutating user 9901 schedule must not modify user 9902 schedule in any way.
If user logs active fever/Jwara, ClinicalRuleEngine must remove active exercise (Vyayama) and insert Bed Rest / Langhana.
If user logs severe Vata insomnia, ClinicalRuleEngine must enforce early Trataka / Meditation and eliminate late night stimulation.
If user logs severe Pitta hyperacidity, ClinicalRuleEngine must enforce cooling practices and replace intense heating routines.
Repeatedly submitting the same schedule mutation must not create duplicate activities or infinite loops.
